full_description:
Project Brief: SARJAN BEAUTY Website and Logo Design

Hi,

I am launching a premium press-on nail brand called **SARJAN BEAUTY** and I am looking for a designer to create a chic, luxury, feminine, minimalist website and logo.

The brand will focus on high-quality press-on nails for busy women who want beautiful nails without spending hours at the salon. Our target audience includes working women, corporate women, busy mothers, women on the go, and women who pray and need nails that are easy to remove and reapply.

Our goal is to create a brand that feels elegant, clean, luxurious, and practical. The customer should feel that SARJAN BEAUTY makes her life easier while still helping her look polished, feminine, and put together.

The sample website we like is **Glamnetic**, especially because it is modern, easy to shop, and product-focused. However, we want SARJAN BEAUTY to feel more elevated, softer, more luxurious, and less loud. We want the website to feel more minimal, clean, premium, and feminine.

## Brand Direction

**Brand Name:** SARJAN BEAUTY
**Product:** Premium reusable press-on nails
**Style:** Chic, luxury, feminine, minimal, elegant
**Mood:** Soft, polished, expensive, clean, modern
**Target Customer:** Corporate women, busy women, women who travel, mothers, women who pray, and women who want salon-quality nails at home
**Main Message:** Beautiful nails made easy, reusable, and removable for your lifestyle

The brand should feel like a mix of:

Luxury beauty brand
Clean girl aesthetic
Soft feminine elegance
Modern convenience
Premium salon quality at home

## Color Palette

Please use a soft, elegant color palette with:

Blush pink
Soft nude
Warm beige
Taupe
Cream
Light brown
Chocolate brown accents
Soft maroon or muted rose as optional accent

The overall look should be neutral, warm, feminine, and luxury. Please avoid bright, childish, neon, or overly colorful designs.

Preferred feeling: **soft luxury, nude tones, blush, brown, clean, elegant.**


## Logo Direction

The logo should be simple, elegant, and timeless.

I would like to see a few options, including:

1. **Text-based logo**
 SARJAN BEAUTY in a clean, elegant font.

2. **Minimal icon logo**
 A small symbol that can be used on packaging, nail boxes, stickers, social media profile photos, and website favicon.

3. **Monogram option**
 Something using “SB” or “SARJAN” in a luxury way.

The logo should feel premium and feminine, but not too girly or childish. I want it to look like a luxury beauty brand that could be sold online and eventually in high-end retail stores.

Font direction:

Elegant serif
Clean modern sans serif
Minimal luxury typography
Soft but strong
Easy to read

Please avoid overly cursive fonts that are hard to read.

Logo colors can include nude, brown, blush, cream, gold, or soft rose-gold tones.

---

## Website Design Direction

The website should be minimalist, clean, simple, and conversion-focused. It should be easy for customers to shop quickly.

The website should feel easy to use and better than other top selling nail websites:

More luxury
Less cluttered
Softer and more feminine
More premium-looking
More focused on lifestyle and convenience
More elegant with neutral colors
Clearer for subscription and reordering

full_description:
We are preparing to launch XPartner, a new social platform, and are looking for freelancers to help onboard genuine users and encourage authentic platform engagement.

Target Cities
Hyderabad
Vijayawada
Chennai
Bangalore
Mumbai
Ahmedabad

Requirement: 10–30 genuine users per city.

Compensation

₹250 per approved profile

Payment will be made only for profiles that successfully pass the verification and quality review process.

User Eligibility
Male and Female users welcome
Must be 18 years or older
Participation must be voluntary
Users must provide original content
Users should be located in one of the target cities
Profile Completion Requirements

A user profile will be considered valid only after completing all of the following:

OTP-verified mobile registration
Unique email address
Profile photo uploaded
Add at least 1 Ex-Partner profile
Use the Search feature at least 5 times
Add 2 Stories on 2 different days
Upload 2 Reel videos on 2 different days
Content Requirements

All stories, posts, and reel videos must be relevant to the purpose of XPartner and should focus on relationship experiences, healing, learning, and moving forward in life.

Suggested Content Categories
Relationship Journey
Lessons learned from past relationships
Relationship experiences
Dating insights
Red flags and green flags
Communication tips
Healing & Recovery
Breakup recovery stories
Emotional healing journey
Self-care after a breakup
Personal growth experiences
Moving forward positively
Motivation & Inspiration
New beginnings
Success after heartbreak
Confidence building
Positive life changes
Inspirational messages
Advice & Awareness
Healthy relationship tips
Relationship boundaries
Trust and respect
Mental wellness in relationships
Common relationship mistakes
Personal Stories
Anonymous relationship experiences
Life lessons learned
Friendship after breakup
Co-parenting experiences
Personal transformation stories
Video/Reel Ideas
Short motivational talks
Relationship tips
Personal experiences
Positive life updates
Inspirational quotes with voice-over
Awareness and educational content
Activity Requirements
Actions must be completed across multiple days
Stories and reels must be posted on different days
Users should engage naturally with the platform
Activity patterns must appear genuine and organic
Strict Compliance Rules

The following are strictly prohibited:

Fake users or fabricated profiles
Bots, automation tools, scripts, or device farms
VPN-based registrations intended to disguise location
Reused, copied, or stolen photos/videos
AI-generated spam content
Forced, incentivized, or misleading registrations
Duplicate accounts created by the same individual
Irrelevant, offensive, or inappropriate content
Verification & Quality Review

All submitted profiles will be reviewed for:

Authenticity
Profile completeness
Original content
Relevance to XPartner
Natural activity distribution across multiple days

Profiles that are incomplete, low quality, duplicated, suspicious, contain irrelevant content, or violate the above requirements will be rejected and will not qualify for payment.

When Applying

Please include:

Target city/cities you can cover
Estimated number of genuine users you can onboard
Previous experience with user acquisition, community building, or social media campaigns

We are looking for quality, authenticity, and meaningful engagement over quantity.

We are an early-stage tech services venture looking for a driven B2B sales professional to close deals. This is not a salaried role — you earn when deals close. If you are a closer who backs yourself and knows how to open doors at decision-maker level, this is worth reading.
This is a Proof of Concept engagement. We are testing the model with a small number of motivated sales professionals. Deliver results and we talk long-term on better terms.

A short, focused engagement to prove one thing — that you can close real B2B deals in our target markets. No salary. No retainer. No guarantee. Pure performance.

Identify and reach out to qualified enterprise and SME prospects
Run discovery calls and qualify budget, authority, need and timeline

Proven B2B sales track record — ideally in tech, IT services, or professional services
Existing relationships with decision-makers in our target segments
Comfortable working on performance — you back your ability to close
